text:
nina: FYI console shows deprecation banner on /generate-route for some tenants even though they're pinned to v1 by route-header. customers are getting mixed routing and quotas are weird

rahul: that sounds like our header precedence mismatch. are we reading x-rw-route-version before token-level affinities?

tom: we changed precedence in the v2 router last sprint to favor header over token affinity for debugging, but forgot to make it opt-in. ops-bot:deploy-1839 applied the change friday night

jin: that would explain banners + quota churn. if header wins, tenants with proxies that inject a debug-header could be routed to v2 for a tiny fraction and trigger deprec banners

nina: can we repro? what query shows affected tenants?

rahul: quick query: ```sql
SELECT tenant_id, route_header, token_affinity, routed_version, sample_count
FROM route_audit
WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours' AND route = '/generate-route'
ORDER BY sample_count DESC
LIMIT 50
```

tom: ran it. found 12 tenants with header!=NULL and token_affinity = 'v1' but routed_version = 'v2' (tiny sample_count ~0.1% of requests)

billing: heads-up: those routed v2 tokens are being billed at v2 rates; if this is accidental we should credit customers and stop billing until we fix routing parity

ops-bot:alert: route-anomaly-detected for /generate-route - 12 tenants - pct_crossed=0.12%

jin: UI side: banners are triggered by any route switch incidence > 0.05% in the last 24h. threshold might be too sensitive for debugging headers

ux: suggestion: change banner logic to require sustained >0.1% over 6h or >0.05% and impacted_tenants > 50 to avoid noisy banners. what do you think?

nina: I'd rather keep threshold low but scope the banners to "customers affected" list and show reason (header_precedence_change). global banners scare customers

rahul: engineering fix options:
1) revert header-preference change in router (quick)
2) make header opt-in via per-hostpool feature flag (medium)
3) keep change and add header normalization + signing so only our proxies can set header (longer)

tom: revert is easiest and will stop new incidents. but we still need a path to safe debugging headers. option 2 + 3 together is ideal

billing: for credits we need a clear time window and an automated script: identify requests routed to v2 where token_affinity='v1' and sum billed units. then issue refunds for the delta. finance-slashed-doc required

jin: for dashboard: add a secondary banner line "Reason: header_precedence_debug" with a link to affected_tenants.csv and a recon button to request credits

nina: recon button should trigger a ticket template for billing + account team with prefilled tenant list and counts

ops-bot:log: created RW-4722 revert-router-header-precedence

rahul: plan:
- revert change (tom) ETA 1h rollback window
- patch router to gate header preference behind opt-in flag (rahul) ETA today
- add signing to proxy headers (jin) ETA next week
- dashboard scope: show per-tenant banner + recon button (ux, nina) ETA EOD
- billing: compute credits and draft comms (billing) ETA tomorrow

tom: starting rollback now. will post deploy id

ops-bot:deploy-1845 started rollback of router-precedence-change by tom

tom: rollback finished, router behaviours back to token-affinity-first. running the audit query to validate

rahul: re-ran audit: cross-routed tenants now 0. Confirming with 6h window

billing: good. will run credit script off v2-rate * misrouted_units and propose comms. will wait for final audit snapshot

ux: will draft banner UI and recon button mock. nina please review copy for "privacy-safe" tenant list export

nina: ack. thanks all. let's add a short postmortem if billing impact > $1000 or >10 customers affected

ops-bot:log: RW-4722 closed (rollback deployed).
